main_issue: Who completes Agent D's half-finished analysis section before Thursday after D's bereavement: the other three covering it, or D working from home to finish it.

A-B.evidence: A asks B to help split D's work (3); B refuses (4); A accepts 'Understood' (5) and then accepts D finishing it herself (13).

A-C.evidence: A asks C to split D's work (5); C refuses (6); A later drops the cover plan and accepts D doing it herself (13).

A-D.evidence: A proposes covering D's section (3); D says 'You don't need to cover for me' (7); A: 'Okay... We are counting on you' (13).

B-C.evidence: Both separately refuse to cover D's work (4, 6) and never address each other.

B-D.evidence: B declines to cover (4), and D says no cover is needed (7). They only exchange condolences (19-20, 43-44), so the outcomes fit but there is no direct exchange on the issue.

C-D.evidence: C says she can't do D's analysis work (6) and D says she will finish it herself (7, 9). They only exchange condolences (23-24).
